meta.note: Every dosage form used in generics.json and brands.json, with its route: 'systemic' = taken by mouth or injection, 'local' = used on the eye, ear or skin or as a mouth rinse. DDInter lists interactions for medicines taken by mouth or injection, so when every catalog brand of a generic is a local form, scripts/extract_ddinter.py leaves out that generic's DDInter pairs and the app says why instead. Forms not used yet are listed so that adding one needs no code change.
